how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-thunder-bluff-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:264:obj:0: Place Clarice's Pendant on Yuriv's Tomb in Silverpine.
rows.quest:264:details:0: Filthy scum! Leaves me for his damn crusade. Because "the Light is the most important thing we have against the threats the undead pose."
rows.quest:264:details:1: BWell, what about his children?! What about ME?! Night after night I sat patiently waiting for him... always second to his blasted duty!
rows.quest:264:details:2: BWell, witness what "justice" brings you, ⟦1⟧! He's dead and I'm bearing the very thing he was trying to stop!
rows.quest:264:details:3: BTake this piece of junk and put it on his tomb at the Sepulcher. I want nothing to do with it anymore... or him!
rows.quest:264:completion:0: You place the worthless pendant on the grave, and the gemstone within the setting seems to dull noticeably.
rows.quest:264:completion:1: BAs you stand to leave, you look down at the pendant; it lies lifelessly over the hands of the relief sculpted into the top of the coffin. Your thoughts are interrupted by a stiff, cool breeze passing over the Sepulcher. For a moment everything around you is silent.
rows.quest:742:obj:0: Speak with Senani Thunderheart at Splintertree Post, ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:742:details:0: Attention, young adventurers! The wilds of ⟦E1⟧ await you!
rows.quest:742:details:1: BThe ⟦E2⟧ has established a strong presence in the lands north of the ⟦E3⟧. Our two outposts - Splintertree Post and the Zoram Strand Outpost - strive to bring glory to the ⟦E2⟧! Those who would prove themselves should seek out guidance there. Of note: Senani Thunderheart in Splintertree Post, directly north of the ⟦E3⟧, seeks adventurers willing to take part in a great hunt of ⟦E1⟧!
rows.quest:742:completion:0: Welcome to the new frontier, ⟦2⟧. ⟦E1⟧ is a land of opportunity, one where a young ⟦3⟧ like yourself is able to find boundless chances to prove their mettle. Look around the outpost here, and be sure to travel out to the Zoram Strand, as the ⟦E2⟧ has another outpost there as well.
rows.quest:742:completion:1: BYour presence here tells me that you've come to learn more about the hunt. Listen close, and I will gladly share with you what you need to know.
rows.quest:744:obj:0: Collect 6 Azure Feathers and 6 Bronze Feathers, and bring them to Eyahn Eagletalon in ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:744:details:0: ⟦4⟧, my brother soon stands before Chief Bloodhoof, and it is my honor to make his headdress for him.
rows.quest:744:details:1: BI want to ask a favor of you while I finish tanning these leather straps. There is not time for me to find enough feathers, and I was wondering, would you gather more for me?
rows.quest:744:details:2: BYou can find feathers of the correct size from the harpies residing far to the north and northwest of ⟦E4⟧. I need only 6 azure and 6 bronze feathers to complete the design.
rows.quest:744:completion:1: BMy part in my brother's ceremony is almost complete. Giving him his headdress and witnessing the ceremony are all my duty requires of me.
rows.quest:768:obj:0: Bring 12 pieces of Light Leather to Veren Tallstrider in ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:768:details:0: Greetings, young one. You have a gleam in your eye; I can tell you are eager to venture back to the plains for the hunt. May you bring honor to your clan!
rows.quest:768:details:1: BI work with the skins of beasts, fashioning them into clothes and armor for the people of ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:768:details:2: BIf you hunt beasts and bring me their skins, then I will fashion something for you.
rows.quest:768:completion:0: Ah, these are very nice pieces. They'll make fine leather goods.
rows.quest:769:obj:0: Bring 4 Light Leather and 4 Coarse Thread to Veren Tallstrider in ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:769:details:0: The kodo beasts of ⟦E5⟧ are strong and sturdy -- traits much respected among us. If you are skilled in leatherworking and wish the knowledge to make a Kodo Hide Bag, then bring me supplies for my trade.
rows.quest:769:details:1: BDo this, and I will share my knowledge with you.
rows.quest:769:completion:0: Ah, good. Thank you, ⟦7⟧. My heart swells with pride to see youths interested in the craft of leatherworking.
rows.quest:1000:obj:0: Speak with Arch ⟦E6⟧ Hamuul Runetotem on the Elder Rise of ⟦E4⟧ about the Cenarion Circle's call to explore the frontiers of ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:1000:details:1: BThe Cenarion Circle seeks able bodied individuals to assist them in exploring the vast new frontiers of ⟦E7⟧! A forbidden wasteland of unimaginable dangers lies far to the west of ⟦E8⟧ and Gadgetzan, and the Circle needs willing and honorable proxies to act in their stead.
rows.quest:1000:details:2: BAll interested individuals should seek audience with the Cenarion Circle. Speak with the Arch ⟦E6⟧ Hamuul Runetotem on the Elder's Rise of ⟦E4⟧ for more information!
rows.quest:1000:completion:1: BI am pleased to see the likes of you taking an interest in the well being of nature; tales of your mighty deeds precede you, and you are welcomed here. Seeing you before me instills the feeling of confidence that the Cenarion Circle will get the proper aid it needs.
rows.quest:1000:completion:2: BOur connection with the Cenarion Circle in ⟦E9⟧ transcends racial and political divides. Remember this as you work on behalf of the Circle, and you will do well.
rows.quest:1064:obj:0: Speak with Apothecary Zamah in the Pools of Vision in ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:1064:details:0: The tauren have a bond with the land, and it pains me to hear of Stonetalon's plight. But I fear that to heal the land, we must first remove the disease upon it.
rows.quest:1064:details:1: BIs it not fortunate, then, that the ⟦E10⟧ are allied with us? They know much of disease. I believe they can aid us, and by doing so they will strengthen the trust between our people.
rows.quest:1064:details:2: BSpeak with Apothecary Zamah. She is a scholar and an emissary of the ⟦E10⟧. You will find her in the Pools of Vision below the Spirit Rise.
rows.quest:1064:completion:0: Magatha sent word of your coming, ⟦9⟧. Although my heart beats no longer, I still feel sorrow for the spirits of Stonetalon.
rows.quest:1064:completion:1: BThe ⟦E10⟧ are eager to offer what help we can.
rows.quest:1065:obj:0: Bring Zamah's Note to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.
rows.quest:1065:details:0: To rid Stonetalon of the Venture Company, we must take extreme measures. Extreme, but without bloodshed.
rows.quest:1065:details:1: BA colleague of mine may have just the tool we need. His name is Lydon; he dwells in the town of Tarren Mill in the ⟦E11⟧, in the distant land of Lordaeron.
rows.quest:1065:details:2: BTo reach Hillsbrad, travel by zeppelin to our capital, the ⟦E12⟧. Then go north to ⟦E13⟧, southwest to Silverpine, and south to Hillsbrad.
rows.quest:1065:details:3: BSeek Lydon and bring him this note. It details our needs to him.
rows.quest:1065:completion:0: A note from Zamah? Her needs must be great to send word from so far. Let us see what she says...
rows.quest:1065:completion:1: BAh, splendid! I know exactly what to do!
rows.quest:1066:obj:0: Bring 5 Vials of Innocent Blood to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.
rows.quest:1066:details:0: I will create a toxin to bleed the violence from the Venture Company, rendering them weak and docile. That should fix the ⟦E2⟧'s problem in Stonetalon, yes?
rows.quest:1066:details:1: BBut to create the toxin, I will need the blood of innocents, a difficult ingredient to obtain.
rows.quest:1066:details:2: BFortunately the ⟦E14⟧, a group of human brigands in this area, employ shadow mages... and those mages collect innocent blood for their own, unsavory purposes.
rows.quest:1066:details:3: BYou can find the ⟦E14⟧ shadow mages in Durnholde Keep to the southeast.
rows.quest:1066:completion:0: Very good! I trust the ⟦E14⟧ gave you little trouble?
rows.quest:1066:completion:1: BAs I mentioned, the blood of innocents is not an easy thing to obtain. We are lucky the ⟦E14⟧ shadow mages did the difficult work for us.
rows.quest:1066:completion:2: BNow hold a moment while I create my concoction...
rows.quest:1067:obj:0: Bring Lydon's Toxin to Apothecary Zamah in ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:1067:details:0: Here is the toxin. If you use it against the Venture Company it should produce favorable, perhaps even contagious, results. I must say, it is quite exciting to see my work applied in the field!
rows.quest:1067:details:1: BBut before using it, take it to Apothecary Zamah. She must create a delivery method for the toxin to maximize its effect.
rows.quest:1067:completion:0: A toxin from Apothecary Lydon? Very good. If I know Lydon, then this toxin will be quite effective against the Venture Company...
rows.quest:1086:obj:0: Bring the Toxic Fogger to the Venture Co. sky port, then return to Apothecary Zamah.
rows.quest:1086:details:0: The toxin is ready. All that remains is its delivery. You, ⟦10⟧, must make that delivery.
rows.quest:1086:details:1: BThe Venture Company must have a means of sending messages and light cargo between its headquarters and its operations in Stonetalon. It is likely a small sky port -- not big enough for a zeppelin, but perhaps for a flying machine. You must search the areas in Stonetalon under control of the Venture Company and find this sky port, if it exists. If you find it, then place the toxin there.
rows.quest:1086:completion:0: You found the port? Well done, ⟦11⟧! I am sure the goblins were quite surprised from your delivery! Let us hope that toxin finds its way to their headquarters.
rows.quest:1086:completion:1: BYou have served your people well, and I advise you to ignore any guilt you might harbor for poisoning the Venture Company. They are deserving of far worse.
rows.quest:1086:completion:2: BAnd if there is one mote of wisdom the ⟦E10⟧ might teach its allies, it is this:
rows.quest:1086:completion:3: BDo not shy from dark paths... if those paths lead to victory.
rows.quest:1123:obj:0: Speak with Rabine Saturna in the village of Nighthaven, ⟦E9⟧. ⟦E9⟧ lies between ⟦E15⟧ and ⟦E16⟧, accessible through a path out of Timbermaw Hold.
rows.quest:1123:details:0: For this task, Keeper Remulos' majordomo in ⟦E9⟧ - Rabine Saturna - seeks aid in exploring the vast wastelands far to the west of ⟦E8⟧ and Un'Goro. He is located in Nighthaven, the main village of ⟦E9⟧.
rows.quest:1123:details:1: BI want to impart on you the importance of your presence. There are growing tensions between the night elves of ⟦E17⟧ and the Cenarion Circle in ⟦E9⟧. Look beyond racial boundaries and tap into the wisdom of your ancestors in dealings with the Circle there, ⟦12⟧. Good luck.
rows.quest:1123:completion:0: I am Rabine Saturna, and on behalf of Keeper Remulos and all of the denizens of this sacred glade I bid you welcome.
rows.quest:1123:completion:1: BI appreciate your interest and eagerness to assist the Cenarion Circle. The tauren have shown an incredible propensity to the tenets of Cenarius, and by their proxy the ⟦E2⟧ is welcomed within the safety of this glade. The preservation of ⟦E18⟧ is a common goal we both share.
rows.quest:1130:details:0: ⟦14⟧, Melor Stonehoof has heard of your deeds, and has set a path before you.
rows.quest:1130:details:1: BIf you wish to take it, then go to ⟦E4⟧ and speak with Melor. You will find him on Hunter's Rise.
rows.quest:1130:completion:0: So, ⟦15⟧, you have come. Now, are you prepared to journey through distant lands?
rows.quest:1130:completion:1: BIf so, young ⟦16⟧, then listen on...
rows.quest:1131:obj:0: Bring Steelsnap's Rib to Melor Stonehoof in ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:1131:details:0: At times we hunt for food. At times we hunt for honor. And at times we hunt to earn the Earthmother's teachings.
rows.quest:1131:details:1: BBut the hunt I now set upon you is none of these things. It is to slay a creature outside the Earthmother's blessing.
rows.quest:1131:details:2: BThe hyena Steelsnap roams the ⟦E19⟧, south of the ⟦E3⟧. He is a tyrant, attracting other hyenas to him and spreading fear and bloodshed among more peaceful beasts.
rows.quest:1131:details:3: BFind Steelsnap, ⟦17⟧. Find him, and defeat him.
rows.quest:1131:completion:0: In defeating the creature Steelsnap, you have cleansed the ⟦E19⟧ of a horrible taint.
rows.quest:1131:completion:1: BAnd that, ⟦18⟧, is your lesson this day.
rows.quest:1136:obj:0: Bring Frostmaw's Mane to Melor Stonehoof in ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:1136:details:0: ⟦19⟧, it is now time for you to travel to far-off lands. You are ready.
rows.quest:1136:details:1: BYou now hunt Frostmaw, a yeti in the ⟦E20⟧. He is elusive, his white coat blending into the snows of his mountain home. He rarely shows himself.
rows.quest:1136:details:2: BBut I will show you how to entice a creature such as he. Here, take this scroll. On it I have written how Frostmaw may be lured.
rows.quest:1136:details:3: BNow go, ⟦20⟧. Your journey is long and many challenges lay waiting. When you return with Frostmaw's mane, only then is your task complete.
rows.quest:1136:completion:0: Both strength and cunning were needed to find and defeat Frostmaw, ⟦21⟧. You have both.
rows.quest:1136:completion:1: BYour path has taken you to the valleys of ⟦E19⟧ and to the high mountains of Alterac. It will one day lead you through all the Earthmother's lands, for such is the way of the hunter.
rows.quest:1195:obj:0: Return a Filled Etched Phial to Zangen Stonehoof in ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:1195:details:0: The Galak centaur in the ⟦E19⟧ are protecting an artifact from the time of the centaurs' creation.
rows.quest:1195:details:1: BWe would like to retrieve it, but we require a phial of water from one of the night elves' moonwells.
rows.quest:1195:details:2: BTo collect the water, you will first need to obtain one of the phials carried by the dryads near the Raynewood Retreat in the heart of ⟦E1⟧ Forest. There is a moonwell near the western bank of the Falfarren River, south of the main road, where you can fill the phial.
rows.quest:1195:completion:0: Very good. This should fill Rau's request just fine. Could you deliver this to him? You might enjoy spending some time out in the Needles.
rows.quest:1196:obj:0: Deliver the Filled Etched Phial to Rau Cliffrunner at the Freewind Post.
rows.quest:1196:details:0: Bring the filled phial to Rau Cliffrunner at the Freewind Post in southeastern ⟦E19⟧. You can get to the ⟦E19⟧ by taking the Great Lift at the southern edge of the ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:1196:details:1: BI wouldn't be surprised if you can help us out further.
rows.quest:1196:completion:0: Hm, yes, this phial of water will serve our purposes perfectly. Because of the shared ancestry of the dryads and the centaurs, the water of the moonwells will enable us to breach the protection of the eternal flame surrounding the centaur relic.
rows.quest:1197:obj:0: Retrieve the Cloven Hoof for Rau Cliffrunner at the Freewind Post.
rows.quest:1197:details:0: Using the water you brought, you will be able to temporarily douse the flame that holds the centaur relic. It will not work permanently, however, so you will have to be quick about it.
rows.quest:1197:details:1: BYou will find Splithoof Crag, the centaurs' stronghold, to the north of here. The flame is kept in Splithoof Hold, a heavily guarded part of the crag.
rows.quest:1197:details:2: BBe careful, though, the Galak centaur have great numbers here, and will be rather reluctant to surrender something so dear to them.
rows.quest:1197:completion:0: I sense a strange energy emanating from the Hoof... I have no doubt that we will discover surprising new information about the centaur from its study.
rows.quest:1197:completion:1: BMy thanks, ⟦22⟧. Now I must begin to decipher the mysteries you have brought to me.
rows.quest:2440:obj:0: Take the reward voucher to Bena Winterhoof in ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:2440:details:0: I shall focus my energies on these discs; they will reveal their true workings to me in due time.
rows.quest:2440:details:1: BAs for you ⟦23⟧, I will now reward you for your diligence in bringing this to my attention. Take this voucher to Bena Winterhoof, the alchemy trainer for ⟦E4⟧. She will give you a special item I believe you will find appealing, and she will supply you with a choice of potions from my personal stock.
rows.quest:2440:details:2: BReturn to me soon, as I sense there is much more at hand for us to do regarding this find.
rows.quest:2440:completion:0: Well ⟦24⟧, you must have pleased Sage Truthseeker greatly for him to give you this item. You are also to be granted a gift from his cache of potions; you may choose between 5 superior healing potions or 5 greater mana potions as your reward.
rows.quest:2965:obj:0: Speak with Nara Wildmane on the Elder Rise in ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:2965:details:0: Ah, ⟦25⟧, it is fortuitous that you have come to me again. Your revelations at the Uldaman dig site have certainly given us sages much discuss. I was doing just that with one of the druids, Nara Wildmane, when it dawned on me that her past adventuring experiences may have some great importance as to the next step we need to take.
rows.quest:2965:details:1: BI would like for you to speak with her concerning her travels to the Valley of the Watchers in the ⟦E8⟧ desert. She waits for you on the Elder Rise.
rows.quest:2965:completion:0: There is a place deep in the ⟦E8⟧ desert called the Valley of the Watchers. The discs that you recovered... their translated glyphs make mention of a place called Uldum. Most think this place to be a myth.
rows.quest:2965:completion:1: BI know this to be false; Uldum exists. I've been there. Well... outside, at any rate.
rows.quest:2965:completion:2: BThe crux is this, ⟦26⟧: we think there is a connection between the discs and Uldum, and we want you to go there.
rows.quest:2966:obj:0: Bring the miniature platinum discs to the gates of Uldum in ⟦E8⟧ and look for clues as to the connection between the two.
rows.quest:2966:details:0: Sage Truthseeker and I would like you to take the miniature discs you found to the sealed gates of Uldum. We... we aren't sure what will happen when you do this.
rows.quest:2966:details:1: BThis sounds risky, sure, we acknowledge that. It might, however, do nothing. You might need to use the discs on something. Perhaps the doors unlock when you have the discs in your possession. Be open to try anything, and be ready for anything to happen.
rows.quest:2966:details:2: BLearn what you can, then return to me. We will have much to discuss.
rows.quest:2966:completion:0: As you touch the pedestal, the miniature discs from Uldaman hum and glow in your backpack. A familiar feeling tingle washes over your hands, as the image of another Stone Watcher springs to life in front of the gates of Uldum.
rows.quest:2966:completion:1: B"Salutations. I am a guardian of entry. The discs that have been used for access are missing the correct entry discs, the Plates of Uldum. Please incorporate these plates with the disc structure and repeat your access sequencing. Thank you."
rows.quest:2967:details:0: You access the pedestal again; the platinum discs suddenly appear once more in your backpack.
rows.quest:2967:details:1: BWith the knowledge of the stone watcher learned and the discs returned to your possession, the time has come to return to ⟦E4⟧ and inform the Nara Wildmane of your discovery.
rows.quest:2967:completion:0: You were missing some discs? Interestingly enough, it seems that the discs of Norgannon are only parts of the complete set - like keys on a key ring, if you will.
rows.quest:2967:completion:1: BIf we can find the Plates of Uldum, then we could actually access the Uldum complex itself. I don't know whether to be excited by that prospect, or be terrified.
rows.quest:2967:completion:2: BWe may need to risk everything to ensure that those secrets the earth keeps which would destroy us all remain just that - secrets.
rows.quest:2968:details:0: Well ⟦27⟧... we seem to be at an unfortunate impasse. We know what we need - the Plates of Uldum - but we have no idea where they might be. We will research this, and then devise a solid plan of attack. I have a couple ideas where to start looking; I have high hopes that soon, we'll be asking you to rejoin our efforts to discover the truth.
rows.quest:2968:details:1: BSage Truthseeker needs to be informed on this, ⟦28⟧; no doubt, he also wants to thank you personally for once again heeding the call.
rows.quest:2968:completion:0: We're all in agreement then - the best course of action is to wait until we can narrow down the areas where these plates might lie hidden. You've brought us this far ⟦29⟧, and I hope you will be the one to head back in to the field to confront the secrets of Uldum.
rows.quest:2968:completion:1: BAllow me to give you this honorarium in the meantime; this should cover any expenses you've encountered in assisting us, and a little something extra. Be sure to check back with us soon... Uldum beckons us all, young one.
rows.quest:3761:obj:0: Bring 20 Un'Goro Soil samples to Ghede on the Elder Rise of ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:3761:details:0: The soil of ⟦E21⟧ is reportedly enriched with potent magical qualities. The Cenarion Circle wants to study this soil in large quantities; go into the wilds of Un'Goro and acquire enough of it for our continued research.
rows.quest:3761:details:1: BThe rich soil will stick out in piles from time to time, and some of the beasts might have usable samples on their being. Take them all outside to Ghede; just look for the piles of dirt and the tauren barking orders. He means well, just don't get him riled up though!
rows.quest:3761:completion:0: Oh that's right Private ⟦30⟧, don't make any effort to help me unload this soil up on to the piles! If the Great Spirits had wanted it done they would have miracled it up there, now wouldn't they?!
rows.quest:3761:completion:1: BArch ⟦E6⟧ Runetotem wants to speak with you again, but for his next task you find that a journeyman's understanding of ⟦E22⟧ would be helpful. If you don't know it though, he'll still find a use for you.
rows.quest:3762:obj:0: Speak with Arch ⟦E6⟧ Hamuul Runetotem in ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:3762:details:0: Excuse me ⟦31⟧, but I'd like just a moment of your time if possible.
rows.quest:3762:details:1: BThe Cenarion Circle in ⟦E4⟧ is most interested in seasoned adventurers such as yourself to lend them aid in a vital research project. While I do not know the specifics, I can inform you that none other than Hamuul Runetotem is spearheading this research.
rows.quest:3762:details:2: BPlease - if you are interested, speak with him directly on the Elder Rise within ⟦E4⟧ proper.
rows.quest:3762:completion:0: Greetings, ⟦32⟧; I am glad you are interested in assisting our research. There is much to do, and I would be doing you a disservice if I informed you that the work this entails is not dangerous. Hopefully this will not scare you off... but from the looks of you, I take it that danger is something that you have dealt with before.
rows.quest:3782:obj:0: Take the Seed Voucher to Bashana Runetotem in ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:3782:details:0: With what we call an Evergreen Pouch, we have cultivated Tharlendris seeds in the soil from ⟦E21⟧. These seeds have blossomed into an array of random, potent herbs. One result is morrowgrain, a mysterious herb we know little about; I very much hope to unravel this mystery for the Circle.
rows.quest:3782:details:1: BTake this voucher over to my daughter Bashana, and she will give you some seeds so you may assist us. If you run out, you will need to purchase more from her.
rows.quest:3782:completion:0: Yes, this voucher is good for twenty packets of seeds. If you run out, we have more that can be provided. Unfortunately though, Tharlendris seeds are quite costly to produce in significant numbers. This is why the Cenarion Circle asks that those who are assisting us help out by offsetting some of the cost.
rows.quest:3782:completion:1: BThose who return with morrowgrain find that the reward the Arch ⟦E6⟧ offers far makes up for the cost.
rows.quest:3786:obj:0: Use an Evergreen Pouch with a Packet of Tharlendis Seeds and two Un'Goro Soil samples to try and cultivate samples of Morrowgrain.
rows.quest:3786:obj:1: BBring 10 Morrowgrain to Bashana Runetotem in ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:3786:details:0: Here's your Evergreen Pouch that you'll need to use the Tharlendis seeds with. You also need to have Un'Goro soil samples on hand to use as fertilizer for the seeds. Just use the pouch when you have everything; the pouch will take care of the rest.
rows.quest:3786:details:1: BWhen you have enough morrowgrain, bring them to me here on Elder Rise. Please don't bother the Arch ⟦E6⟧; he'll be very busy with the research, as well as the multitude of concerns he has!
rows.quest:3786:completion:0: Well done ⟦33⟧, I will be sure to give these to the Arch ⟦E6⟧ himself when he has need of them. Meanwhile, please accept this as a token of the Cenarion Circle's appreciation.
rows.quest:3786:completion:1: BOur need for morrowgrain, for now, is constant; if you wish to continue aiding us, then please return when you have cultivated more of it.
rows.quest:7820:completion:0: Wonderful! We thank you for your generous donation, ⟦34⟧!
rows.quest:7821:completion:0: Wonderful! We thank you for your generous donation, ⟦35⟧!
rows.quest:7822:completion:0: Wonderful! We thank you for your generous donation, ⟦36⟧!
rows.quest:7823:completion:0: Fantastic - these will go right to use, I assure you. Thank you again for your assistance! We'd certainly be lost without you.
rows.quest:7823:completion:1: BWith all the donations you've made, I would certainly process any additional runecloth donations you care to make in the future. Just be sure to check in with me, and I'll personally make sure that your good deeds won't go unrecognized!
